source_mapping: Research/Submission.lean formalizes the full active lemma:traingular_update in /spec/source.txt and /spec/paper.tex lines 403-452. Source coordinates 1,...,k correspond to Fin k values 0,...,k-1. The inner product uses exactly the first k-1 entries; its first rounded product initializes the accumulator and subsequent additions are rounded. IsEvaluation existentially quantifies bounded local relative errors for these operations, subtraction, and division; this is the standard floating-point model under no overflow/underflow, with no assumed algorithmic bound. Unit roundoff is nonnegative and k*u<1. computedValue is the actual evaluation, and perturbation gives an explicit witness with dot-product factors and inverse final-operation factors. triangular_update_constructed states the exact backward equation and every gamma_k component bound for this witness; triangular_update states the source existential result for every such evaluation. Supporting source.txt, paper.tex, references.bib, and source.pdf were copied unchanged to Research; /spec/support contained no files. No feedback.json was present; no feedback-driven statement revision was made. The plan is used only as a fallible handoff. Only the proof of triangular_update_constructed is temporarily sorry; all construction definitions have actual bodies, and triangular_update is derived from it.
